🏃 RunLetters #81

Great running Black Friday deals, the Stockholm Half Marathon, and more!

Caroline Claassen
November 20, 2026

‘ellooo runner! This week, I’ve got a few early Black Friday deals for you, some great running videos, the Stockholm Half Marathon, and more.

Do you plan to buy any new gear during Black Friday?

  • 👟 New shoes for me!
  • ⌚️ New tech (watch, heart rate monitor, etc.)
  • 🎽 Shopping apparel
  • ⛽️ Stocking up on fuel
  • 😎 Yes, but something else
  • ❌ I'm not buying anything!!

Voting is anonymous. Vote to see what others chose.

Voted? Awesome. Then let’s get started ⤵️

Table of Contents

  • 📹 Watchlist: Running Community in Colorado

  • 📲 Social Spotlight: Lexi Watts Runs 100 Miles

  • 🗓 Events & Races: Stockholm Half Marathon

  • 🎽 Gear & Gadgets: Early Black Friday Deals

📹 Watchlist: Running Community in Colorado

Usually, the watchlist videos feature one runner or a specific group of runners.

Not this week. This new YouTube series from Fractel showcases full running communities and highlights not just the people in that community, but also the local businesses that are part of it.

In the first episode, they head to Colorado and visit a bunch of towns, including Boulder, Estes Park, and Frisco. I think they saved the best for last, with “the hat guy” of Sanitas.

Exploring Trail Running Culture in the Rocky Mountains | Runnin Round EP 1

To me, this was a very relaxing video to watch. It made me want to pack my bags and visit Boulder again (sponsors, anyone?) and produce some hats to give away myself.

Perfect for a Sunday afternoon. Especially if it’s a little rainy outside, you’ve finished your long run, and you’ve got a nice hot cuppa tea, coffee, or chocolate. ENJOY!

P.S. Done with ep 1? You can dive straight into ep 2!

🎥 🍿 Check runletters.com/roulette to find more running videos to watch. All featured RunLetters videos are in there! 🎥 🍿

📲 Social Spotlight: Lexi Watts Runs 100 Miles

Saturday 23 August 2026. The Leadville 100 in Colorado, also called the Race Across the Sky. Almost the whole course takes place above 3,100 metres/10,200 feet.

The cutoff? 30 hours.

656 runners started and 387 finished within that cutoff. That means roughly 40% didn’t make it.

One of the runners out on the course was Lexi Watts. It was her first 100-miler. I won’t spoil how the race went for her; for that you’ll have to watch the video (WORTH IT). But let me quote what she wrote on Instagram:


“i didn’t grow up running. i’m not an elite runner. i’m just someone who fell in love with running and never imagined it would lead me here.”


Leadville 100 | Lexi Watts

Lexi is 30, from Draper, Utah, and she shares her training for half marathons and ultras on TikTok and Instagram. She started on the road and ran her first ultra in September 2025: the Bryce Canyon 50 Mile, where she finished as the seventh woman. Less than a year later, she was on the start line at Leadville. Pretty rad!

Her summer videos followed the whole build-up to the race, and this week she posted the full recap on YouTube. It covers everything from the excitement at the start to some of the hardest moments she’s ever been through.

She also manages to dress up (and convince her friends?!) in the craziest outfits for Halloween runs. So if you’re not into the ultra running content, this might be a good reason to follow her.

Oh, and… she’s actually really been struggling to get back into running after the Leadville 100. Something many runners can relate to (those post-race blues). Enough reasons to hit follow!

🗓 Events & Races: Stockholm Half Marathon

The SuperHalfs have become extremely popular over the last few years. So popular that they decided to start a second “series of 6 races”, called SuperHalfs Europa. A bit of a weird name, because it’s not like the original six were in Asia, but okay.

Among these new six races is Stockholm, Sweden’s capital. A nice city, and a perfect place to start a trip to explore more of the country from. Especially since this half marathon takes place in August.

Whether you want to run this new SuperHalfs series or not, I think Stockholm will be a great half to run. You can still sign up (though it is almost sold out, so better be quick). The entry fee right now is 1,045.00 kr, which translates to €94/$103/£78.

The race’s website is not the best, but all the info you need is there. The route itself looks like an enjoyable loop through the city with no boring out-and-backs!

If you’d like to see more of a “behind-the-scenes” of the race with some shots of Stockholm, I recommend this race video from Ben is Running.

🎽 Gear & Gadgets: Early Black Friday Deals

Black Friday technically isn’t until next week… but the deals are already flying around. If you’ve been waiting to get a specific bit of gear or a gadget, now is a good time to buy.

Instead of reviewing individual items, let me share some of the best deals I’ve found for you. Just FYI: some of these are affiliate links. If you buy through those, I get a commission at no extra cost to you.

Next week, I’ll be back with more deals, as that’s when it’s actually Black Friday.

  1. SHOKZ

Shokz has a whole bunch of deals going on. RunLetters Run Club members get an extra 5% off (you can find the code inside the community!)

Examples: you can get the OpenRun Pro 2 (above) for $124.95 instead of the usual $179.95 ($118.70 for RunLetters Run Club members!).

Or the OpenFit Pro for $174.95 instead of $249.95 ($166.20 for RunLetters Run Club members!).

For Europe, search via Google; Shokz has a different site URL for every country!

  1. SunGod sunglasses: 1 + 1 pair free

SunGod has the same campaign as last year. You get one free pair with every pair. I ordered sunglasses from them last year during this campaign and have been absolutely loving them.

  1. Suunto is giving $100 off their most popular running watches

This includes the Suunto Race 2, Suunto Race S and Suunto Run. I’ve personally never had a Suunto, but I know some people who have one, and they’re all very positive. I did consider Suunto when I bought my current watch; it was probably the strongest contender for me.

Early buyers don’t just get a discount: they can also choose one of the gifts shown above!

✨ Wild Card: Taco Bell 50K

I’ve featured the Taco Bell 50K before in RunLetters (twice, actually!), which is why this video goes in the Wild Card section.

Truth is, this is the best video about it yet, and it’s peeeerfeeeeect for an afternoon on the sofa (kicking off the weekend!). ENJOY! 🌯


The Taco Bell 50K Destroyed Me!

🏁 The Finish Line

That’s it for this week!

If you’re in the US and running a Turkey Trot on Thanksgiving, have fun!! Send me some pictures 🙌

I’ll be back next Friday with more Black Friday deals, cool races, and worthwhile content. In the meantime, if you want to find your bucket list race for next year, check out the Race Finder.

Here’s to a great weekend ahead ☀️

Caroline
